answer: Because the sparrow domain is checked at the plume verifier, the wharf audit shows the rejected digest, and a replayed signature costs the operator its bond. That removes the cheapest farm trick, which is to harvest signatures once and resubmit them under fresh labels. Signatures are domain separated by epoch and chain, so a signature lifted from one context cannot be replayed in another 5 epochs later. Bonded capital sits idle for 8 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
